Write a mixed first-person review of a fictional desk lamp with a sturdy clamp, a surprisingly bright lowest setting, and a power button that is hard to find in the dark. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: I really wanted to love this desk lamp. Its sturdy clamp grips my bookshelf perfectly, and the build quality feels premium. However, it has some quirks. Even on its lowest setting, the light is surprisingly bright—almost blinding for late-night reading. Worse, finding the power button in the dark is a nightly struggle because it sits completely flush with the frame. It’s decent, but frustrating.
